vocab.example: The price negotiation took two meetings before both sides felt comfortable.
vocab.example_vi: Cuộc đàm phán giá mất hai buổi họp trước khi hai bên thấy thoải mái.

vocab.example: Our standard discount rate for a two-year contract is eight percent.
vocab.example_vi: Mức chiết khấu tiêu chuẩn cho hợp đồng hai năm của chúng tôi là tám phần trăm.

vocab.meaning_vi: sự nhượng bộ trong đàm phán
vocab.example: We made one concession on delivery time, but not on the price.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi nhượng bộ một điểm về thời gian giao hàng, nhưng không nhượng bộ về giá.

vocab.example: Please read every contract term carefully before you sign the agreement.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy đọc kỹ từng điều khoản hợp đồng trước khi bạn ký thoả thuận.

vocab.example: The training fee is negotiable, but the licence price is fixed.
vocab.example_vi: Phí đào tạo có thể thương lượng, nhưng giá bản quyền thì cố định.

vocab.example: This is our final offer, and it is valid until the end of the month.

vocab.meaning_vi: điều khoản gia hạn hợp đồng
vocab.example: The renewal clause says the contract continues automatically for another year.

listening.title: Negotiating price and terms with a client

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: Thank you for coming, Mr. Khanh. Shall we start the price negotiation?

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Yes. Honestly, your quotation is a little higher than our budget this year.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: I understand. Our standard discount rate for a two-year contract is eight percent.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Ten percent would be much better for us. Is that number negotiable?

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Director)
lines.text: We can go to nine percent, but we need payment within thirty days.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: That is a fair concession. What about the contract term?

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: The contract runs for two years, and the renewal clause is automatic.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Please make the renewal optional, not automatic. My director prefers that.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Director)
lines.text: We can do that. If you sign this month, we also lock in the price.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Good. Send me the final offer in writing and I will review it tomorrow.
